mission: First survey world reveals anomalous ruins with unrecognized markings — the pattern that will lead to the fortress
why_now: The survey mission's overt purpose (cataloging post-crisis Force anomalies) collides with the covert pattern Ben is unconsciously following
conflict: The ruins don't match any known Jedi, Sith, or pre-Republic tradition in Ben's training. Standard survey protocols can't categorize them.
turning_point: Ben touches one of the markings and feels the wrongness spike — these ruins are connected to whatever is causing the disturbance
opening_hook: The ruins are older than they should be on a world that was surveyed sixty years ago and recorded as uninhabited
closing_hook: Ben records the markings and sends the data to Luke — but holds back his Force impression. First withholding.
emotional_trajectory: Professional curiosity -> growing unease -> quiet alarm

stakes.personal: Ben's trust in his own perception vs. the official record
stakes.interpersonal: His first moment of withholding from Luke — the institutional lie subplot seeds
stakes.external: Something older and stranger than the recent crises left these marks

setting: Unnamed Outer Rim survey world — arid, rocky terrain, ruins half-buried in wind-erosion
sensory_details: Dry wind; markings carved into stone with unfamiliar tools; the wrongness like standing near a speaker playing a frequency just below hearing; Desh's boots crunching on gravel
canon_elements_needed: Outer Rim archaeological survey procedures for Force anomalies
Force interaction with ancient artifacts and ruins
Jedi record-keeping and reporting hierarchy to the Council
Pre-Republic and Jedi Lords era construction styles
Thin place theory and Force-strong locations in Legends EU
action_beats: Ben and Desh hike across rocky terrain toward half-buried ruins
Ben crouches to examine carved markings and his fingers brush the stone surface
Ben recoils from the Force spike when he touches the marking — physical jolt
Ben records the markings with his datapad scanner, deliberately omitting his Force impression from the transmitted data
notes: First thin place encounter — very mild. The Force responds but distances are wrong. Ben notices; Desh feels nothing overt, maybe unease without a source. Voice note: Zahn-precision in the archaeological observation — Ben catalogs before he hypothesizes. Allston-rhythm in the Desh dialogue — banter that masks growing concern.
